_comment: Raptor's test egg (docs/EGGS.md#built-in-catalog): checks that a node can install, start, reach, talk to, and stop a server.
name: Raptor test server
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A tiny server for checking a node works: it answers in a browser on its port and says "ok" to status in the console. Nothing to download but Python.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash # Writes the test server into the server's directory. set -euo pipefail mkdir -p /mnt/server cat > /mnt/server/server.py <<'EOF' # Raptor's test server: answers HTTP on the server's port with MESSAGE, # and "status" on the console. If you can open it in a browser and type # status here, the node, its firewall, and the egg pipeline all work. import http.server import os import sys import threading port = int(os.environ.get("SERVER_PORT", "8080")) message = os.environ.get("MESSAGE", "It works!") served = 0 class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): global served served += 1 body = ("Raptor test server" "

" + message.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<") + "

" "

Served by a Raptor test server.

").encode() self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print("request from " + self.client_address[0] + ": " + (fmt % args), flush=True) httpd = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), Handler) threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start() print("Raptor test server is ready on port " + str(port), flush=True) try: for line in sys.stdin: if line.strip() == "status": print("ok: " + str(served) + " request" + ("" if served == 1 else "s") + " served", flush=True) elif line.strip(): print("unknown command; try status", flush=True) except KeyboardInterrupt: pass print("stopping", flush=True) httpd.shutdown() EOF echo "Raptor test server installed"

variables.name: Message
variables.description: What the page on the server's port says.
